text:
mia: quick signal from nightly perf sweep — seeing kernel handoff thrash on sm90 nodes for certain seq_len ranges. p99 token latency jumps ~3-4x when kvcache churns.

mia: snippet from the nightly run: 
```
[RUN] model=redwood-7b-v1 device=sm90 seq_len=64 batch=8 kernel=fast_tc bf16=on
latency p50=28ms p95=42ms p99=120ms
kvcache_hit_rate=63% kvcache_evictions=420/min
handovers: selected fast_tc -> generic_gemm after 2 retries
```

ash: ugh. do we have the hw fingerprint that led to fast_tc pick? sometimes sm90 dims (warp/lanes) plus driver picks tensorcore path incorrectly for mixed seqlens.

mia: yes, profiler dump attached (small excerpt):
```
arch_sig=SM90A: tc_supported=true bf16_fast=true cuda_driver=535.54
cap_mask=0x1f4 kernel_hint=prefer_tc
seq_histogram: 1-32:40% 33-64:45% 65-128:10% >128:5%
```

kai: probable root cause: our route-heurstic is greedy on hw flags + short cumulative latency sample. when seqlen distribution has a bimodal hump near 48-68 we get optimistic TC picks but per-token kv misses (evictions) amplify the cost.

kai: proposal: add short-term hysteresis and kv-aware utility. i.e. prefer fast_tc only if (expected_kv_eviction_rate < X) OR sustained improvement over N=3 windows. else select generic_gemm.

sam: i can prototype a tiny change to route scoring: score = base_latency_est - (kv_evictions_per_token * eviction_penalty) - (prefetch_miss * miss_penalty). will test on bench.

mia: also saw one weirdness: when fallback happens we do immediate kernel flip which thrashes the kvcache (different memory layout for KV blobs) -> cascade. so add smooth handoff: keep old KV mapping for 1 more request or warm-up prefetch.

ash: +1. that sticky mapping could reduce churn by avoiding rapid layout toggles. we should also add metric: kernel_route_switches and kv_evictions/sec (per route) so we can alert before p99 spikes.

perf-bot: :rotating_light: perf alert created: alert/perf/5187654321 - p99_latency_multiplier > 2.0 for sm90 nightly sweep

kai: for autotuner test, i recommend a synthetic workload: 60% seqlen=48, 40% seqlen=64, kv_window=32k, and run 10k inferences to reproduce. include both warm and cold kvcache phases.

sam: i ran that locally with a patched scorer (eviction_penalty=0.8). results: p99 dropped from 118ms->46ms on my sm90 laptop (single card). still need to validate on multi-node farm.

mia: great. next steps:
- sam: push prototype PR with scoring change + unit tests for route scoring (assign to eng-runtime)
- ash: add metrics (kernel_route_switches, kv_evictions/sec) to runtime telemetry and alert rule (SLO playbook update)
- kai: design sticky-kv mapping or delta-prefetch flow and write design doc (2 days)

ash: putting tickets now. sam, can you also include a small script to simulate layout toggles so QA can replay?

sam: yep will add a replay harness to infra/perf-tests.

mia: rollout plan: canary 10% on dedicated sm90 pool, monitor kernel_route_switches and p99 over 24h. auto rollback if p99 > 2x baseline or kv_evictions/sec increases by >50%.

deploy-bot: planned deployment: eng-runtime/canary -> 10% group at 2026-03-19T02:30Z. rollback policy attached.

ash: assigning reviewer to PR: @kai. thanks team — this matches a few support tickets we've seen.

mia: thanks — i will keep the thread updated with farm numbers.

(End)
